name: Image · ADetailer
description: Built-in Image Finish extension for detector-guided face and detail repair, family-aware sampling, optional dedicated repair models, isolated detailer LoRAs, identity protection, diagnostics, replay, and output inspection.

notes: Supports generation-model reuse and an isolated SDXL or SD 1.5 detailer checkpoint.
Other model families require a compatible compiled workflow route and supported detailer nodes.
Modern-family ADetailer execution is experimental and requires an exact compiler-owned route contract plus family-owned preset.
Every explicit LoRA request uses the loader strategy published by the active compiler and fails closed when the node signature or live catalog cannot be proven.
Physical GPU-backed validation remains required before promotion from experimental availability.
Qwen Image Edit 2509/2511 detailer-only and identity LoRAs use the compiler-owned LoraLoaderModelOnly route; CLIP is not patched.
LoraLoaderModelOnly is conditionally required only when an explicit Qwen Edit detailer LoRA is enabled.
Native/component routes reapply compiler-published model-sampling lineage after the model-only LoRA; GGUF passthrough routes do not invent wrappers.
Identity assistance is experimental and is never represented as a guarantee.
Krea 2 uses compiler-owned model, conditioning, VAE, sampler, and final-image references.
Detailer LoRAs patch the generation model only; the Qwen3-VL text encoder remains unchanged.

workflow_patch_contract.dispatch_order: after image.high_res_lab and prior model/conditioning extensions
